# 苏宁易购 (Suning.com)

> > Suning.com is China's leading omnichannel retail platform offering home appliances, electronics, and consumer goods with integrated trade-in programs and government subsidies.

Suning.com operates as a comprehensive e-commerce ecosystem featuring brands like Haier, Little Swan (小天鹅), Midea (美的), Siemens, and Casarte. The platform integrates financial services (易付宝, 苏宁金融, 任性付) and mobile services (苏宁互联) with extensive product catalogs, trade-in programs, and government subsidy initiatives for home appliance upgrades.

## Key Topics

- 苏宁易购 (Suning.com e-commerce platform)
- Home appliances and electronics retail
- Trade-in programs (以旧换新)
- Government subsidies (政府补贴)
- Little Swan (小天鹅) washing machines
- Haier (海尔) appliances
- Midea (美的) kitchen appliances
- Siemens (西门子) premium appliances
- Casarte (卡萨帝) luxury brand
- 易付宝 (Yifubao payment)
- 苏宁金融 (Suning Finance)
- 任性付 (Renxingfu credit)
- 苏宁互联 (Suning Mobile)
- Brand rankings and comparisons
- Product images and specifications
